name: hud_cmd_bind_button_base_destructor_core
description: HudCmdBindButtonBase::DestructorCore releases each command-binding entry and its display text, frees the binding vector buffer, destroys the bind-panel list selector item, chains to HudUiCheckToggleWidget::DestructorCore, and returns.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred for the HudCmdBindButtonBase/HudCmd*Button destructor cluster. Current source preserves the observed cleanup order; Binary Ninja still renders the VC vector cleanup as an impossible [end,end) move range plus EH state writes.
